line: Every day brings hidden gifts. Leave them unused, and it quietly takes them back.
credit: Ralph Waldo Emerson · Works and Days, 1870

line: We want to know what's inside. But it's all uncertain. So, be patient.
credit: Ajahn Chah · Not Sure!, Dhamma talk

line: Patient, not idle: young Iyengar began yoga to grow strong for life's challenges.
credit: B. K. S. Iyengar · Light on Life, 2005

line: The body needs a little work each day, never too tiring, never forced.
credit: Quoted by Sun Simiao · Qianjin Yaofang, c. 652

line: And after 40, a more flexible body went with more flexible blood vessels.
credit: Yamamoto et al. · Am J Physiol, 2009

line: Not proud in success, not crushed in defeat. Whatever comes, never lose heart.
Daily 13-minute meditation eased bad moods and sharpened focus, but only after 8 weeks.
credit: Basso et al., NYU · Behav Brain Res, 2019

line: Musicians say: skip practice one day, you notice. Skip three, everyone notices.
And years of steady yoga, it is said, build an unshakable mind.
credit: William James · The Energies of Men, 1907

line: Shaping each day is the highest art. Open tomorrow's gifts on your Ashtanga mat.
